headline: Tatum and George handle business in Orlando while Patriots survive Miami
morning_brew: The C's are absolutely cookin', picking up a wicked nice road win over the Magic on Sunday. Jayson Tatum was a total machine, dropping thirty-two points with fifteen of those coming from the charity stripe, and Paul George chipped in with seventeen to help seal the 108-97 victory. It was their fifth straight win, and while the early season standings are a tight race, this group is starting to look like the contender we all expected. I'm not sayin' anything, I don't wanna jinx it, but this team is starting to put a real deposit in the Duck Boat fund.

Down in Miami, the Patriots actually got the job done on Sunday. Drake Maye looked sharp with two touchdowns, and the defense held firm in a 24-19 win that felt like a long time coming for this squad. We've had more than our fair share of nightmares playing the Dolphins on the road — I swear, watching us play down there is like watching my cousin Jimmy try to parallel park a bus — so snatching a victory like that is a massive confidence boost. It wasn't always pretty, but you take the win and keep moving forward.

Looking ahead, the Hub has a busy Monday night on tap. The B's are back at the Garden tonight for a tilt against Vegas, and you know I will be glued to the TV hoping for a strong showing on home ice. Meanwhile, the C's are out in Houston looking to extend their winning streak to six. It is a big night for Boston sports, so grab your Dunks and settle in, because the action starts early.

news_digest.headline: Jayson Tatum's 32, Paul George's 10 4th-quarter points lead Boston Celtics to win at Orlando
news_digest.dans_take: Another night, another impressive team win for the boys that keeps the momentum rolling.
